about: a price-time order book: bids and asks as heapq heaps of Order objects ordered by __lt__, an index of orders by id, match a loop over both heaps, cancel by marking an order's quantity 0

lines: # gdp: law the book no longer crosses: forall b in self.bids: forall a in self.asks: b.price < a.price
# gdp: law a fill takes no more than an order rests: forall o in old(self.bids): o not in self.bids or o.qty <= old(o.qty)
# gdp: law a cancelled order rests no more: forall o in self.bids: o.order_id != order_id
